subject: SIG-lite request: keystore manifest delivery + rotation clarifications
messages:
From: Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@monolith-finance.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: SIG-lite: keystore manifest + rotation history request

Hi Sean,

Thanks for taking this — Monolith is running a quick SIG-lite review ahead of procurement. To close our encryption/key-management checklist we need the following artifacts and a couple clarifications: 

1) Keystore manifest (mapping of tenant IDs -> key IDs, algorithm, wrap mode) for our tenant sample (tenant IDs: MNL-101, MNL-102).
2) Key rotation timeline for the last 12 months (UTC timestamps, rotated-by who/role, rotation reason).
3) HSM attestation or vendor-signed certificate for the HSM providing KEK wrapping (if available).
4) Short note confirming: a) whether transit keys (wrapping/unwrapping KEKs) are rotated automatically; b) whether any customer-managed KEKs are retained by Redwood post-onboarding.

Preferred delivery by July 30 EOD PT. If you prefer an SFTP/upload or shared Drive link, that'll work fine — we can accept zipped manifests and PEM attestation files.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director, Infrastructure Security
Monolith Financial

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
To: Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@monolith-finance.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG-lite: keystore manifest + rotation history request

Daniel — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble the artifacts and redact any tenant-specific secrets before delivery. Quick notes / ask from our side: 

- Delivery options: we can upload to a restricted Drive folder (preferred) or push to your SFTP. Which do you want?
- Format: we'll provide a CSV manifest and a PDF timeline; HSM attestation will be included as a PEM or signed PDF depending on vendor output.
- For the rotation timeline we'll include role (e.g., "service-account:rotation-bot" or "platform-ops:user") and a short reason code (routine / emergency / rekey).

I've looped in Ben (contracts/sales) to coordinate transfer and Irene/Laura from Security/Compliance to confirm redaction scope. Expect the first bundle by tomorrow morning PDT.

Sean Gallagher
Head of Customer Reliability (on rotation)
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@monolith-finance.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG-lite: keystore manifest + rotation history request

Daniel — attaching the package per Sean's note. Files are in the Drive link below (shared with your domain for 30 days). We redacted customer plaintext key material and left key IDs + metadata. Attachment list below: 

- keystore-manifest-20260726.csv (columns: tenant_id,key_id,algorithm,wrap_mode,created_at)
- rotation-timeline-20260726.pdf (tabular rotation log, UTC)
- hsm-attestation-20260726.pem (vendor-signed attestation, base64 PEM)

Delivery link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB3-example-link 
JIRA ticket: SEC-4821 (internal only)

Notes: 
- Customer-managed KEKs: for your account (Monolith) we did not retain customer root KEKs after BYOK handoff; only wrapped KEK metadata is stored.
- Transit/wrapping keys: KEK wrapping keys for the hosted service are on a 90-day rotation cadence by default and rotated automatically by the platform; we included the last three rotations in the timeline (2025-11-02, 2026-02-28, 2026-05-30).

If you want the raw CSV zipped and SFTP'd instead, reply with an upload target and we can push it.

Best,
Ben Carter
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Attachments: keystore-manifest-20260726.csv; rotation-timeline-20260726.pdf; hsm-attestation-20260726.pem

From: Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@monolith-finance.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Desai <audits@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG-lite: keystore manifest + rotation history request

Ben / Sean — received, thanks for the fast turn. A couple quick clarifications from our audit team: 

- In the CSV manifest we see wrap_mode values "kms-wrap" and "hsm-wrap" — can you confirm whether "kms-wrap" corresponds to software-wrapped KEKs or a KMS service backed by an HSM?
- For the 90-day rotation cadence: do emergency rotations (e.g., detection of key compromise) trigger an immediate rotation with an audit event retained? We want to confirm your retention window for those audit events.

If you can drop one-line answers in thread we'll mark this as resolved for SIG-lite. Otherwise we may ask for the small audit event extract.

Thanks,
Daniel
